correctness.rationale: All finite-dimensional irreducibles, including the even-n one-dimensional characters, are accounted for; the three-root lemma and mixed two-by-two determinant establish the individual nullities for every n. The counting proof separates mixed pairs by additive order and pure triples by primitive reductions, yielding totient/Euler-product multiplicities and the 3-adic total. Direct integer left-regular convolution matrices were independently rank-compared for every support n=3..14 using two finite-field reductions; these are checks, not replacements for the proof.
